A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the relationship between oil and equity markets is not stable over time, it varies across countries and is influenced by the level of volatility in oil markets.
the oil market is a source of uncertainty for equity markets, and the relationship between them is not always linear.
oil is not the only driver of equity prices in MENA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the correlation between oil and MENA equites is not stable, and it is subject to change in both the long and short term.
the association between oil prices and equities is time-varying and that the short-term association can break from the long term association, which is a feature of the DCC-Midass model.
